title: Close the canonical K ingress floor with ping-pong paired-dimension writes
hypothesis: Two automatic-target transpose buffers and one 256-bit bank write can sustain the canonical 256-bit ingress rate while preserving exact p53/p54 producer behavior.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Which concrete buffering/write-width organization reaches the K ingress floor without changing score-cluster semantics?
include: one-buffer serial analytical and RTL reference
4,096 consecutive canonical flits per K head
8,192 exact p53/p54 producer beats and independent stalls
